answer: False crews cannot split a single adit claim. An applicant stakes 7.20 POA and is allotted one of 21 ridge adits for 15 minutes. They press an 8.4 cm jade tablet into wet gangue, then quench a seed-bound 18-bit crystal lattice of vein-angle, pubkey, and epoch seed so the adit pyrometer logs it in seconds 19-46. 104 aliases would lock 748.80 POA and need 104 exclusive adits. Auditors replay the adit draw from the seed, regenerate the lattice, and measure the tablet to 0.07 cm. A reused adit, weak quench, or lattice clash burns 50% and seals that claim for 7 epochs.
